paite: "Huan kuapeuh athil muh hiam, athil zak hiam a dia theihpih ahih a, kichiamsakmi aw azak a leng gen nuam lou a, thil ahihkhelhleh athulimlouhna moh apo ding”.
heading: Khelhna Thillat A Poimohna Thubuaite
english: “‘If anyone sins, in that he hears the voice of adjuration, he being a witness, whether he has seen or known, if he doesn’t report it, then he shall bear his iniquity.

paite: "Kuapeuh in thilsiang lou himhim, gamsa siang lou luang hiam, gan siang lou luang hiam, avakthoh ganhing siang lou luang hiam thei lou a, akhoihkhakleh, siang lou leh mohtang ahi ding hi”.
english: “‘Or if anyone touches any unclean thing, whether it is the carcass of an unclean animal, or the carcass of unclean livestock, or the carcass of unclean creeping things, and it is hidden from him, and he is unclean, then he shall be guilty.

paite: "Mihing leng asianlouhna bangpeuh hi hen aw, asianlouhna thei lou a, akhoihleh atheihkhiak hun in siam louh atang ding hi”.
english: “‘Or if he touches the uncleanness of man, whatever his uncleanness is with which he is unclean, and it is hidden from him; when he knows of it, then he shall be guilty.

paite: "Kuapeuh in thil hoih lou hiam, thil hoih hiam hih dia, akam a thei lou a, akichiam zialzialleh, akoi abang hitaleh, akichiam zialzialna atheihkhiak hun in siam louh atang ding hi”.
english: “‘Or if anyone swears rashly with his lips to do evil, or to do good, whatever it is that a man might utter rashly with an oath, and it is hidden from him; when he knows of it, then he shall be guilty of one of these.

paite: "Huan hichi ahi ding a, hiai thilte khat a leng siam louh atan chiang in akhelhna apuang ding ahi.
english: It shall be, when he is guilty of one of these, he shall confess that in which he has sinned:

paite: Khelh thoihna ding in belamhon lak ah anu, belamnou hiam kel hiam, athilhihkhelhsa man ding in TOUPA kiang a lat ding in khelhna thoihna ahon tawi dia; siampu in akhelh tungthu ah kilemna abawlsak ding ahi”.
english: and he shall bring his trespass offering to Yahweh for his sin which he has sinned, a female from the flock, a lamb or a goat, for a sin offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin.

paite: "Aneih in belamnou achin zoh keileh TOUPA kiang a lat ding in akhelh man ding in akhelh thoihna ding in vakhu nih hiam, vapalnou hiam ahon tawi ding ahi. Khat, khelh thoihna ding in, akhat pen halmang thillat ding in.
english: “‘If he can’t afford a lamb, then he shall bring his trespass offering for that in which he has sinned, two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, to Yahweh; one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering.

paite: Siampu kiang ah ahon tawi dia, ama'n khelh thoihna ding in alan masa dia, phelkhap lou in angawng ah alu ahektan ding hi.
english: He shall bring them to the priest, who shall first offer the one which is for the sin offering, and wring off its head from its neck, but shall not sever it completely.

paite: Khelh thoihna sisan maitam pang ah tam lou atheh dia, asisan om lai teng maitam bul ah atakkangsak ding hi. Hiai khelh thoihna ahi.
english: He shall sprinkle some of the blood of the sin offering on the side of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be drained out at the base of the altar. It is a sin offering.

paite: Akhat pen dan dungzui in halmang thillat ding in alan dia; siampu in athilhihkhelhsa tungthu ah lemna abawlsak dia”, ngaihdam ahi ding.
english: He shall offer the second for a burnt offering, according to the ordinance; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin which he has sinned, and he shall be forgiven.

paite: "Himahleh vakhu nih hiam, vapalnou nih hiam aneih zoh keileh akhelh man thillat ding leh khelh thoihna ding in tangbuang nel dimdem, ephah mun sawm a khen mun khat ahon tawi ding hi. Sathau a buak ding ahi kei a, atung ah begaw akoih ding ahi kei; khelh thoihna ahih ziak in.
english: “‘But if he can’t afford two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, then he shall bring his offering for that in which he has sinned, the tenth part of an ephah 1 ephah is about 22 litres or about 2/3 of a bushel of fine flour for a sin offering. He shall put no oil on it, neither shall he put any frankincense on it, for it is a sin offering.

paite: Siampu kiang ah ahon tawi dia, siampu in theihgigena ding in apham khat ala dia, maitam tung ah TOUPA a ding in mei a thillat bang in ahal ding ahi. Hiai tatlek thoihna ahi.
english: He shall bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it as the memorial portion, and burn it on the altar, on the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. It is a sin offering.

paite: Huai thillak a abangmah leng ahihkhelhsa tungtang thu ah siampu in kilemna abawlsak dia, ngaihdam ahi ding. A-om lai teng tangbuang thillat bangmah in siampu tantuam ahi ding," achi hi.
english: The priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin that he has sinned in any of these things, and he will be forgiven; and the rest shall be the priest’s, as the meal offering.’”

paite: "Kuapeuh in thil ahihkhelh a, TOUPA thil siangthoute tung a akhelh khakleh, akhelh thoihna, belamhon lak a belampa gensiatbei, Mun siangthou shekel bang in, dangka shekel bangzah hiam gun a ngaih, tatlek kithoihna ding in TOUPA a ding in ahon kai ding ahi.
english: “If anyone commits a trespass, and sins unwittingly, in the holy things of Yahweh; then he shall bring his trespass offering to Yahweh, a ram without blemish from the flock, according to your estimation in silver by shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering.

paite: Thil siangthou tung a ana hihdiklouh khitsa pen adin dia, amun nga a khen mun khat abehlap dia, siampu ape ding ahi. Huchi in siampu in tatlek thoihna belampa in kilemna abawlsak dia”, ngaihdam ahi ding.
english: He shall make restitution for that which he has done wrong in the holy thing, and shall add a fifth part to it, and give it to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and he will be forgiven.

paite: "Kuapeuh in thil ahihkhelh a, hih louh dia TOUPA'N thu apiakte khatpeuh ahihleh, thei kei mahleh siam louh atang himhim dia, athulimlouhna moh apo ding ahi.
english: “If anyone sins, and does any of the things which Yahweh has commanded not to be done; though he didn’t know it, yet he is guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.

paite: Belamhon lak a belampa gensiatbei, aman kilawm hun, tatlek thoihna ding in siampu kiang ah ahon kai ding ahi. Siampu in theiloupi a hihkhelh khak tungthu ah kilemna abawlsak dia, ngaihdam ahi ding.
english: He shall bring a ram without blemish from of the flock, according to your estimation, for a trespass offering, to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning the thing in which he sinned and didn’t know it, and he will be forgiven.

paite: Hiai tatlek thoihna ahi a; TOUPA ma ah talek mah ahi," achi hi.
english: It is a trespass offering. He is certainly guilty before Yahweh.”
